title: HeavyTailedNcsc.lean

problem_class.label: nonconvex
problem_class.details: The minimization variable x is unrestricted; convexity in x is not assumed.

problem_class.label: saddle_point
problem_class.details: Unconstrained minimax problem Φ(x)=max_y f(x,y), with μ-strong concavity in y and jointly L-Lipschitz partial gradients; 0<μ≤L.

oracle.label: stochastic_gradient
oracle.details: One call at (x,y) returns both partial stochastic gradients using one fresh IID seed. Both components are unbiased. No function values or samplewise smoothness are assumed.

distinctive_assumptions.label: heavy_tailed_noise
distinctive_assumptions.details: Uniform joint central-moment bound E[(‖ox−gx‖²+‖oy−gy‖²)^(p/2)]≤σ^p, with 1<p≤2 and σ≥0; variance can be infinite when p<2.

distinctive_assumptions.label: finite_dimensional
distinctive_assumptions.details: E and F are finite-dimensional real inner-product spaces with Borel measurable structures.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Initialization satisfies ∀x,y ∃y′, f(x0,y)−f(x,y′)≤Δ and ‖gy(x0,y0)‖≤G, with Δ,G≥0. All Params, including L,μ,p,σ,Δ,G,ε,δ,x0,y0, are public; f and the oracle distribution are hidden.

accuracy.label: gradient_norm
accuracy.details: A measurable output x must satisfy ‖∇Φ(x)‖≤ε. Success also requires existence of a global maximizing selector y*(x); the guarantee holds for every such selector.

accuracy.label: high_probability
accuracy.details: P(‖∇Φ(output)‖>ε)≤δ, where ε>0 and 0<δ<1/2. Probability includes algorithm randomness and oracle seeds; oracle cost is bounded by the fixed supplied budget.
accuracy.evidence: LongTails/Setups/HeavyTailedNcsc.lean: spec.successful, spec.valid; LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence, executeWithTrace

setup_category.label: classical
setup_category.reason: Smooth nonconvex–strongly-concave minimax optimization with unbiased IID bounded-p-moment gradients and high-probability primal stationarity is an established research formulation.

descriptionHtml:
Heavy-Tailed Nonconvex Strongly Concave Optimization

We consider infx∈Emaxy∈Ff(x,y) on finite-dimensional real inner product spaces E and F. The differentiable objective f:E×F→R has an L-Lipschitz joint gradient and is μ-strongly concave in y, with L≥μ>0, while it may be nonconvex in x. Given initial points, an initial value-gap bound, and an initial dual-gradient bound, the oracle returns unbiased gradient pairs from independent, identically distributed samples with bounded centered pth moment, 1<p≤2. The goal is a measurable output x¯ with ∥∇Φ(x¯)∥≤ε with probability at least 1−δ, where Φ(x)=maxyf(x,y), ε>0, and 0<δ<1/2.

Write the objective and optimization problem as Φ(x)=maxy∈Ff(x,y),infx∈EΦ(x). Equip E×F with the product norm ∥(u,v)∥=(∥u∥2+∥v∥2)1/2. The given points are x0∈E and y0∈F. The parameters satisfy 0<μ≤L,1<p≤2,σ,Δ,G≥0,ε>0,0<δ<12. The algorithm receives E,F, the measurable sample space Ω, all these parameters, and x0,y0; the objective and sampling law are accessed through the oracle.

Our assumptions:

Assumption 1 (Smoothness and strong concavity). Both partial gradients of f exist everywhere. For all z,z′∈E×F, ∥∇xf(z)−∇xf(z′)∥2+∥∇yf(z)−∇yf(z′)∥2≤L2∥z−z′∥2. For every x∈E and y,y′∈F, f(x,y′)≤f(x,y)+⟨∇yf(x,y),y′−y⟩−μ2∥y′−y∥2.

Assumption 2 (Initial bounds). For every x∈E and y∈F, there exists y′∈F such that f(x0,y)−f(x,y′)≤Δ. The initial dual gradient satisfies ∥∇yf(x0,y0)∥≤G.

Assumption 3 (Heavy-tailed stochastic gradients). Let ν be a probability measure on Ω. The oracle maps gx:(E×F)×Ω→E,gy:(E×F)×Ω→F are jointly measurable. At each fixed z∈E×F, both maps are Bochner integrable under ν and satisfy Eξ∼ν[gx(z,ξ)]=∇xf(z),Eξ∼ν[gy(z,ξ)]=∇yf(z). Define the paired error by e(z,ξ)=(gx(z,ξ)−∇xf(z),gy(z,ξ)−∇yf(z)). For every z, the random variable ∥e(z,ξ)∥p is integrable and Eξ∼ν[∥e(z,ξ)∥p]≤σp. The samples (ξk)k≥0 are measurable, mutually independent, and each has law ν under their joint law. At query zk∈E×F, call k returns the pair (gx(zk,ξk),gy(zk,ξk)), using the same sample for both components. Algorithm randomness is independent of the sample sequence.

Queries may be made anywhere in E×F. The output requirement includes the existence of a maximizing selection y⋆:E→F satisfying f(x,y)≤f(x,y⋆(x))for every x∈E, y∈F. For every such selection, the measurable output x¯∈E must satisfy P(‖∇[x↦f(x,y⋆(x))](x¯)‖>ε)≤δ, where P is the joint law of the samples and the independent algorithm randomness. Since every maximizing selection represents Φ, this is the high-probability stationarity requirement for the value function.

comparisonHtml:
Finite-dimensional real inner-product spaces; jointly L-Lipschitz gradient, μ-strong concavity in y, 0<μ≤L. Write Φ(x)=maxyf(x,y), with Φ(x0)−infΦ≤Δ and ∥∇yf(x0,y0)∥≤G. Jointly measurable IID unbiased joint-gradient oracle with central pth moment at most σp, 1<p≤2. Target: Pr(∥∇Φ(X)∥>ε)≤δ, ε>0, 0<δ<1/2.

Heavy-tailed NC–SC minimax optimization: HeavyTailedNcsc.

(1): noise coefficient κr+1→κr/2; deterministic κ2→κ. Extra noise term absorbed when A≥1/κ, up to logs. Certifies a selected point. (1): IID required; adds κQ, explicit ℓ2r+3 and enormous p-dependent prefactor.
(3) Stoc-TRGDAmax (Zhu et al. 2026), Thm. 4.3, (4.9); unregularized restriction O(Aκ1+r/2+Aκr+1(σ/ε)r) calls for expected random-iterate norm ≤ε, provided ε≥2L∥y0−y∗(x0)∥. (1): no composite regularizers or expected-norm guarantee; IID required. Markov conversion of (3) costs δ−(r+2) in its noise term, within its initialization regime.

import LongTails.Template
import LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex
import Mathlib.Analysis.Calculus.Gradient.Basic
import Mathlib.Analysis.SpecialFunctions.Pow.Real

open MeasureTheory
open scoped RealInnerProductSpace

namespace LongTails.Setups.HeavyTailedNcsc

open OracleTemplate

structure Params where
  E : Type
  [normedE : NormedAddCommGroup E]
  [innerE : InnerProductSpace ℝ E]
  [finiteE : FiniteDimensional ℝ E]
  [measurableE : MeasurableSpace E]
  [borelE : BorelSpace E]
  F : Type
  [normedF : NormedAddCommGroup F]
  [innerF : InnerProductSpace ℝ F]
  [finiteF : FiniteDimensional ℝ F]
  [measurableF : MeasurableSpace F]
  [borelF : BorelSpace F]
  Ω : Type
  [measurableΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω]
  L : ℝ
  μ : ℝ
  p : ℝ
  σ : ℝ
  Δ : ℝ
  G : ℝ
  ε : ℝ
  δ : ℝ
  x0 : E
  y0 : F

attribute [instance] Params.normedE Params.innerE Params.finiteE Params.measurableE Params.borelE
  Params.normedF Params.innerF Params.finiteF Params.measurableF Params.borelF Params.measurableΩ

abbrev spec : Setup where
  Params := Params
  Public := Params
  Instance q := q.E → q.F → ℝ
  Query q := q.E × q.F
  Reply q := q.E × q.F
  Output q := q.E
  publicInput q := q
  valid q := 0 < q.μ ∧ q.μ ≤ q.L ∧ 1 < q.p ∧ q.p ≤ 2 ∧ 0 ≤ q.σ ∧
    0 ≤ q.Δ ∧ 0 ≤ q.G ∧ 0 < q.ε ∧ 0 < q.δ ∧ q.δ < 1 / 2
  admissible q f O :=
    ∃ (gx : q.E × q.F → q.E) (gy : q.E × q.F → q.F)
      (ox : q.E × q.F → q.Ω → q.E) (oy : q.E × q.F → q.Ω → q.F)
      (p : ProbabilityMeasure q.Ω) (P : ProbabilityMeasure (ℕ → q.Ω)),
      LongTails.Setups.StochasticGeneralizedSmoothAndConvex.IID
        (fun k (ξ : ℕ → q.Ω) => ξ k) (p : Measure _) (P : Measure _) ∧
      O = { Seed := fun _ => q.Ω
            law := P
            answer := fun _ (_, z) ω => (ox z ω, oy z ω) } ∧
      (∀ x y, HasGradientAt (fun x' => f x' y) (gx (x, y)) x) ∧
      (∀ x y, HasGradientAt (fun y' => f x y') (gy (x, y)) y) ∧
      (∀ z z' : q.E × q.F, ‖gx z - gx z'‖ ^ 2 + ‖gy z - gy z'‖ ^ 2 ≤
        q.L ^ 2 * (‖z.1 - z'.1‖ ^ 2 + ‖z.2 - z'.2‖ ^ 2)) ∧
      (∀ x y y', f x y' ≤ f x y + ⟪gy (x, y), y' - y⟫ - q.μ / 2 * ‖y' - y‖ ^ 2) ∧
      (∀ x y, ∃ y', f q.x0 y - f x y' ≤ q.Δ) ∧
      ‖gy (q.x0, q.y0)‖ ≤ q.G ∧
      Measurable (Function.uncurry ox) ∧ Measurable (Function.uncurry oy) ∧
      (∀ z, Integrable (ox z) p) ∧ (∀ z, Integrable (oy z) p) ∧
      (∀ z, ∫ ω, ox z ω ∂p = gx z) ∧ (∀ z, ∫ ω, oy z ω ∂p = gy z) ∧
      (∀ z, Integrable (fun ω =>
        (Real.sqrt (‖ox z ω - gx z‖ ^ 2 + ‖oy z ω - gy z‖ ^ 2)) ^ q.p) p) ∧
      (∀ z, ∫ ω, (Real.sqrt (‖ox z ω - gx z‖ ^ 2 + ‖oy z ω - gy z‖ ^ 2)) ^ q.p ∂p ≤ q.σ ^ q.p)
  successful q f output P :=
    Measurable output ∧ (∃ ys : q.E → q.F, ∀ x y, f x y ≤ f x (ys x)) ∧
      ∀ ys : q.E → q.F, (∀ x y, f x y ≤ f x (ys x)) →
        (P : Measure _) {ω | q.ε < ‖gradient (fun x => f x (ys x)) (output ω)‖} ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal q.δ

end LongTails.Setups.HeavyTailedNcsc
